title: finding(core): ValueDataSource widens an empty operator map ({ status: a, created: {} } and { created: {} }) that the ObjectStack path now refuses (objectstack#5240)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (b) (one authored filter, two fates). Reader: triage first (route and grade).

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from objectui#10788's dev report (`5857786405`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) and the contract review of PR objectui#10810, which recommended this card (suggested grade: bug · p3 · `area:records`, a sibling of objectui#9164 and objectui#10788).

## Measured (the dev's probe on PR objectui#10810's head `5cc126bfd0`; the UI door was NOT measured)

`ValueDataSource.find` (a published `@object-ui/core` export) with an object `$filter`, over rows `[{id:'1',status:'a',created:'x'},{id:'2',status:'a'},{id:'3',status:'b'}]`:
- `{ status: 'a', created: {} }` → rows `1`, `2` (the same as `{ status: 'a' }`);
- `{ created: {} }` → rows `1`, `2`, `3` (every row).

## Why it is wrong

- objectstack#5240 ruled `{ field: {} }` (a field constrained by zero operators) refused everywhere. `@objectstack/spec` records this on `FilterConditionSchema`'s docblock, and driver-memory's `emptyFieldConstraintError` refuses it.
- In objectui, `convertFiltersToAST` refuses it alone (objectui#9164) and beside a key that lowers (objectui#10788, PR objectui#10810). So the same authored filter is refused on the ObjectStack path and silently widened on the value path.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

- `ValueDataSource`'s object-`$filter` matcher refuses an empty operator map with the same `FilterOperatorError` (`INVALID_FILTER`, naming the field) that `convertFiltersToAST` throws. Reuse its throw site, or route the object filter through it; ⛔ no second wording.
- Pin both inputs above as refused, with `{ status: 'a' }` as the control.
